QuestInfo.name: The Seal of the Empire
QuestInfo.0: Seems like #b#p1300003##k wants to tell you something...
QuestInfo.1: You need to find the stolen Royal Seal of the Mushking Empire and bring it to #b#p1300003##k.
QuestInfo.2: You found the #bPrime Minister#k, who stole the #bRoyal Seal of the Mushking Empire#k. You reclaimed the seal and returned it to #b#p1300003##k.
QuestInfo.summary: You need to find the stolen Royal Seal of the Mushking Empire and take it to #b#p1300003##k.

0.0: I...actually have something that I'd like for you to look for on my behalf.
0.1: When King Pepe invaded our castle, we were so busy trying to evacuate from the premises that I couldn't find the Royal Seal that was supposed to be locked inside the castle's safe. The Royal Seal is the symbol of our kingdom, and I can't imagine who would have stolen it from us. Please find it for me...

yes.0: If that Royal Seal turns out to be in King Pepe's possession, then it'll allow him to officially announce the wedding between his son and Princess Violetta, not to mention take over of the Empire. The only ones who have the authority to open the safe are #bMushking#k himself, #bVioletta#k, the #bPrime Minister#k and me... Anyway, we must find that Royal Seal at once.

no.0: Please think about it and reconsider. The future of our Empire is at stake.

1.0: You found the Royal Seal! Thank you so much!

yes.0: I've been told the #bPrime Minister#k was responsible for this mess. It is most unfortunate. There is a saying in this land: 'He who thinks only of his own cap will find the stem of despair.' It sounds much better in the original Mushroomese, I assure you. Now then, with our Royal Seal returned, our focus can turn once again to rebuilding our great empire.

item.0: The Royal Seal is the symbol of our Empire. We must retrieve it at once!
